scenes.text: It takes 150 flowers to make one gram of this spice.
Course one begins in a field at dawn. One gram of saffron takes about one hundred and fifty flowers.
Each flower blooms for only a few days a year, and holds just three crimson threads. Every thread is picked by hand, before the sun can fade it.
The threads are slowly dried, until deep red turns to liquid gold. Did you already know? That is why saffron is the most expensive spice on Earth.
Back in the kitchen, the chef soaks the threads in warm milk. Good to know: this releases the color and flavor, so a pinch can paint a whole pot of rice.
